notes.title: Out of early access after exactly one year
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Steam community![/h1] 

This is the developer of [b]Soulbind: Tales Of Underworld[/b], Arylhan from Rubedo Games. In the last few months, finalizing the game from a pet project has turned into a solo development. Yes, I was not able to realize everything I had planned, but I was able to master Unity. But still I am glad that I was able to complete this chapter of my life, and in the future, if it turns out to develop a new game, I have a prototype of one game and the concept of another, I will have to choose. 

[i]Small bugs still remain, so I will fix them little by little.

[/i] [i]Best wishes, [/i] 
[b]Arylkhan from Rubedo Games[/b].

tags.bug: Small bugs still remain, so I will fix them little by little.

notes.title: New weapons are now in the game.
notes.content:
[h3]Merchant Strogovich continues his journey through the world of Allaar.[/h3] 
Now the merchant has appeared in the player base with new items. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272279/8d0224c0827b15966be16af6830bd534a1a6c79d.png[/img]
Use new weapons that completely change the style of the game.

[list] 
[*] Added 3 new weapons and a shield; 
[*] Made rebalance of dropable shards in favor of increasing; 
[*] Zombie in the sewer is heavily poisoned and turned into a toxic zombie; 
[*] Weapons are now different rarities.
[/list] 

Because of the new weapons old saves will not work, if you want to restore you will need to send me to support@rubedogames.com all the contents of the folder C:\Users\Your profile\AppData\LocalLow\Rubedo Games\Soulbind_ Tales Of The Underworld in the letter specify the date of the save.

notes.title: The demo is available to players again!
notes.content:
[h3]The new update to version 0.9.9 is available for players, the following changes have been made:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Optimized the size of the altar and gate badge;
[*] Improved the Stone Skin ability;
[*] Fixed ropes;
[*] Fixed the layers on the character doll in the altar window;
[*] Removed shards in the HUD;
[*] Added trap damage to mobs.
[/list].

We have also released a demo version and in connection with this we are holding a [b]Giftaway keys[/b].

[b]Conditions:[/b]

 Make a video recording of the passage from the start of the level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272279/603b128c238d9b66dd4e7f2174672034308dd200.png[/img]
 
To the end of the level (gate)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272279/8404ce576e30f356306773e12ef9f6108a909cff.png[/img]

2 nominations: 
[list]
[*] Speedrun - for running through the level without getting into fights; 
[*] Sweep - for destroying all mobs and trap rooms.
[/list].
Talents are not purchased. The record of the race must be posted in Youtube in the public domain with the channel mark @rubedogames

[b]Additional conditions: [/b]subscribe to twitter and instagram - not mandatory, but will be taken into account in case of the same passage of time of participants.

Due to level generation, keys will be given to at least 3 fastest participants in each category.

notes.title: Early Access update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272279/6fb8d36770fb572c571297302349c1bc8a3be310.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that [b]"Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld"[/b] is ready for Early Access on [b]October 9[/b]! Now you have an opportunity to dive into the world of dark fantasy and become a part of this exciting adventure.

Especially for our beloved players, we are upgrading the game's demo version to a pre-release version, coinciding with the Steam "Next fest" demo festival.
We have added:
[list]
[*] mutation system;
[*] passive abilities;
[*] improved combat system;
[*] traps in locations;
[*] updated balance and level design.
[/list]
For the best game experience, we recommend deleting old saves and creating new ones.
We have also decided to release the game in early access with more locations and monsters.


Rubedo games team
